svg.title: Simulated XRD phase evolution of a bioactive silicate ceramic sintered at 700 to 1100 °C
svg.desc: Stacked, offset X-ray diffraction patterns (Cu Kα) for 700 to 1100 °C with reference stick patterns for wollastonite, whitlockite and hydroxyapatite/fluorapatite.
svg.text: Bioactive silicate ceramic · powder XRD · Cu Kα (λ = 1.5406 Å) · simulated patterns, offset for clarity
▼ wollastonite (Wo), ■ whitlockite (Wh) and ● hydroxyapatite / fluorapatite (HA/FAp) mark each phase's strongest reflection where present.
HA and FAp overlap at Cu Kα and cannot be separated by XRD alone.
Schematic: patterns are simulated; peak positions and relative intensities are approximate and peak widths illustrative.
Replace with measured scans and ICDD/COD peak lists before citing.
